claim_scope: development probe only; not a frozen V2 registration
data_boundary: v242 replay/reset manifest JSONL and referenced agentview JPEGs only; no tape/summary/task-definition/simulator/event/milestone/success/BDDL access

causal_reacquisition.later_locator_failure: omit object prompt; SAM2 uses past memory

sift.causal_rule: each frame uses only that frame RGB plus the fixed episode-0 template
sift.family: OpenCV SIFT cluster + affine-partial-2D RANSAC causal re-acquisition
sift.later_locator_failure: soft: omit that object prompt and use past-only SAM2 propagation
sift.prompt_rule: inverse-distance weighted centroid of RANSAC-inlier scene keypoints
sift.relation_evidence_rule: use affine-projected template center only when it lies in the current prompted target mask; otherwise retain the current SAM target-mask centroid

template_derivation.data_boundary: RGB-only calibration; no event, success, simulator-state, or task-definition input
template_derivation.rule: exact t0 RGB-visible SAM mask bounding boxes from development episode 0
